identity.title: Recreational Marijuana Producer License — Evergreen Botanicals, LLC (Bailey Hill)

scan.summary: This is the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission's Recreational Marijuana Producer License (Tier II, Indoor) for Evergreen Botanicals' Bailey Hill premises. It is the agency's own authorizing document, not something the company drafts, so there is nothing in it to fix — what matters is meeting its five conditions and renewing before the term ends. The current term runs March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027, and the license authorizes a 10,000 sq ft mature canopy at that single address.
scan.freshness_note: Current term began March 3, 2026 and runs to March 2, 2027. This is roughly six months into a one-year term as of September 27, 2026 — not yet due for renewal, but the renewal window and 20-day submission deadline should be calendared now.

conditions.title: Premises-only, non-transferable license
conditions.evidence_expected: No evidence needed unless a change of location or ownership is contemplated; then a new application or transfer filing with OLCC.

conditions.title: Annual renewal filed at least 20 days before expiration
conditions.evidence_expected: Renewal application and fee submission confirmation from the OLCC portal (CAMP), dated on or before February 10, 2027, plus any confirmation that a complete pending renewal keeps the license active past expiration.

conditions.title: All marijuana items tracked in CTS; every handler holds a current worker permit
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS account records/reports showing inventory tracked, and a current roster of employee marijuana worker permits (permit numbers and expiration dates) for everyone handling product.

conditions.title: Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450, 90-day retention
conditions.evidence_expected: Surveillance system documentation (camera coverage plan, retention logs) showing at least 90 days of recordings are kept and cameras meet the rule's technical requirements.

conditions.title: Report ownership, premises, or financial-interest changes before they take effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Copies of any change-of-ownership or premises-modification notices filed with OLCC, or a statement that no such changes have occurred.

conditions.title: Display the license at the premises
conditions.evidence_expected: A note or photo confirming the license is posted where visible to the public at Bailey Hill.

deadlines.title: Renewal application and fee due to OLCC
deadlines.source_line: A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date.

facts.affects: Identifies which OLCC license this permit record corresponds to for renewals and inspections.

facts.quote: License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
facts.affects: Sets the canopy size class and indoor-only cultivation method the company is authorized for.

facts.quote: Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
facts.affects: Caps the mature-plant growing area at Bailey Hill; exceeding it would be a licensing violation.
Defines the active license period and drives the renewal deadline.

facts.quote: recordings kept for at least 90 days
facts.affects: Sets the minimum surveillance footage retention the company must maintain.

facts.value: every employee who handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit
facts.quote: every employee who handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission
facts.affects: Requires individual OLCC worker permits for all staff handling product, separate from the site license.

expected_missing.title: Current marijuana worker permits for individual employees
expected_missing.why: The license conditions require every handler to hold one, but the company's file does not yet show any worker permit records
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Cannabis Tracking System (CTS) access and reporting records
expected_missing.why: Condition 3 requires all marijuana items tracked in CTS; companies typically keep CTS user logs and periodic reports on file
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Video surveillance system documentation / retention logs
expected_missing.why: Condition 4 references OAR 845-025-1450; producers usually keep camera placement diagrams and retention logs to show the 90-day requirement is met
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Land use compatibility statement and water rights/source documentation
expected_missing.why: OLCC producer licensing generally requires these at application and renewal for the licensed premises
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Pesticide and agricultural chemical use records
expected_missing.why: OAR division 25 imposes recordkeeping on pesticide/fertilizer use for producers; commonly held alongside the license
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in reading the license's identifying details, term dates, and conditions directly from the document. I checked the video-surveillance citation (OAR 845-025-1450) and the 20-day renewal rule (consistent with OAR 845-025-1190 and the related late-fee rule 845-025-1070) against current public sources and found them consistent with what's stated in the license. I could not verify from this document alone whether the company currently holds the underlying worker permits, CTS access, or surveillance logs the conditions require — those are separate records not part of this license.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
